info.title: Tier0 OpenAPI
info.description: Tier0 Enterprise OpenAPI v1. Send `x-api-key` to OpenAPI endpoints except public file downloads. Effective permissions are the intersection of API key permissions and the owner's role permissions. Call `POST /auth/whoami` to verify the current identity and permissions before integration work.

200.description: Legacy upload response. The current Enterprise implementation returns an empty uploadUrl; use /assets/files for new integrations.

400.description: Correct the request parameters or Content-Type before retrying.

401.description: Authentication middleware returns plain-text unauthorized. Check API key validity, scope, and owner roles.

403.description: Authentication middleware returns plain-text forbidden. Check API key validity, scope, and owner roles.

404.description: Resource not found. Verify paths, IDs, and current resource state.

409.description: Resource state conflict. Verify paths, IDs, and current resource state.

413.description: Request too large. Reduce the request before retrying.

500.description: Service error. Investigate the service and confirm the outcome before retrying.

post.summary: Create a legacy asset upload URL
post.description: Legacy compatibility endpoint. The current Enterprise implementation returns an empty uploadUrl; use /assets/files for new integrations.
Returns value, quality, and timeStamp (VQT) for each requested topic. A failed topic does not discard successful items in the same batch.

200.description: Request accepted. **Important:** HTTP 200 does not mean every write succeeded. Inspect `data.results[].success`; when it is `false`, inspect that item's `error`.

400.description: Invalid request or a business validation error. Correct the request before retrying.

401.description: Authentication middleware rejected the API key. This response can be plain text rather than a JSON envelope.

403.description: The API key is valid but lacks the required permission, or its owner's role does not permit the write. This response can be plain text rather than a JSON envelope.

404.description: A requested topic was not found. Confirm the full topic path before retrying.

409.description: The topic is in a conflicting state. Refresh its current state before retrying.

413.description: The request is too large. Reduce the request size before retrying.

500.description: Service error. Confirm the write outcome before retrying to avoid duplicate or unintended writes.

post.description:
Writes values to existing TOPIC nodes. Each value must match the node payload schema.

**Batch outcome:** a batch can contain both successful and failed items. Inspect `data.results[].success` and the per-item `error`; do not treat HTTP 200 alone as proof that every write completed.

**Retry safely:** first confirm the outcome. Retry only corrected, failed items; do not blindly resend a write after a timeout or server error.
Returns a UNS subtree. Use an empty path for the workspace root.
Searches UNS node names, aliases, and paths, with optional type and path filters.
Queries historical topic values over an inclusive RFC 3339 time range. Results can be aggregated or sampled.
Creates UNS nodes and nested subtrees. Check each item result and use the returned topic in subsequent calls.
Updates an existing UNS node. Empty strings, an empty fields array, and an empty extendProperties object retain existing values.
Deletes the listed nodes sequentially. By default this is a soft delete; the batch is not rolled back when a later item fails.
Restores a soft-deleted UNS node. Permanently deleted nodes cannot be restored.
Uploads a multipart attachment for a UNS node. Supply a file and at least one of unsId or topic; a valid unsId takes precedence.
Lists attachments for a UNS node or topic. Temporary file URLs can expire and must then be requested again.

post.summary: Bind a flow to a UNS node
post.description: Binds a flow ID to a UNS node ID.
Issues an object-store upload form; it does not transfer file contents. Submit every returned post field unchanged with the file.

get.description: Returns file bytes directly. Do not forward x-api-key or other credentials when a client follows a redirect to a cross-origin storage URL.

parameters.name: filePath
parameters.description: Server-issued storage path returned by an upload API.

parameters.name: responseContentDisposition
parameters.description: Optional Content-Disposition value for the download response.

302.description: Redirect to the final download URL.

get.description: Downloads bytes for a file explicitly marked public. An unguessable path is not authorization; do not mark sensitive files public.

parameters.name: filePath
parameters.description: Server-issued storage path returned by an upload API.

parameters.name: responseContentDisposition
parameters.description: Optional Content-Disposition value for the download response.

200.description: Returns file bytes directly. Content-Type depends on the file type; no JSON envelope is used.

get.description: Creates a temporary URL for a file.

parameters.name: filePath
parameters.description: Server-issued storage path returned by an upload API.

parameters.name: expiredSec
parameters.description: Requested temporary URL lifetime in seconds.

post.description: Deletes a file identified by its server-issued storage path.
Creates a multipart upload session and returns its ID, part size, and part count.
Returns presigned PUT URLs for the requested one-based part numbers.
Completes a multipart upload after every uploaded part number and ETag have been supplied.
Cancels a multipart upload session.

post.summary: Inspect the current API key identity
post.description: Returns the current API-key identity and its effective permissions. Call this before integration work to verify access.
Lists flows, optionally filtered by a keyword or flow category.
Returns flow metadata for a numeric flow ID.
Creates a SourceFlow or EventFlow and returns its numeric resource ID.
Updates flow metadata and settings for a numeric flow ID.
Deletes the listed flows sequentially; earlier deletions are not rolled back when a later item fails.
Returns the Node-RED canvas revision and node objects for a flow.
Deploys a complete Node-RED canvas JSON string to a flow.
Returns the Node-RED node sets available for a flow category.
Returns the service name, version, reported capabilities, and configured MQTT broker.

parameters.name: projectName
parameters.description: Project name in the Launchpad URL. URL-encode special characters.

post.description: Lists Launchpad project members. URL-encode projectName when it contains special characters.
Creates a normal MQTT credential. The returned password is available only once and must be stored securely immediately.
Idempotently deletes a normal MQTT credential. System credentials are not deleted.
Lists platform members with optional keyword, role, status, and update-time filters.
